subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - EZE / 153 CTN 1,247 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 84789 (Landshut), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include that service in the all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 4 pieces of sports equipment, with a gross weight of 996.49 lb and a total volume of 73.46 cubic feet.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply so our purchasing department can file it.

Thank you for your assistance.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-07
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - EZE / 153 CTN 1,247 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to EZE:
153 CTN / 1,247 KGS / 16 CBM, furniture samples
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer requests a new all-in air freight quote for a shipment from Landshut to SGN.
